name: Persistent TSO (PTSO)
description: Persistent-memory model layering buffered epoch persistency on top of the TSO / x86-TSO consistency model. It adds an orthogonal persist-order axiom (what survives a crash on non-volatile memory) rather than reordering reads/writes: the crash-free behaviour coincides with TSO, while persistency governs the order in which store-buffered writes reach NVM. Given both operationally and declaratively.

catSupport.note: A declarative epoch-persistency axiom layered on TSO — per-execution, but persist and crash events are outside herd7's event vocabulary, so no cat model exists.
